text: In Bad City, an Iranian ghost town, a young woman in a chador skateboards the night streets and [lets the men who prey on others take her home|rules|how it hunts]. Arash, a hard-working young man burdened by his father's heroin debts, meets her lost and high in a Dracula costume, and in her room she [resists his exposed neck|threat|blood drinkers]. He [pierces her ears for a pair of stolen diamond earrings|images|clothes, jewellery and keepsakes], untroubled by her talk of terrible deeds, while the pimp and then his own father [meet her in the dark|who_suffers|the guilty punished].
